note: 30-item starter pack (3rd Rate to Peak). Import from Dashboard → Items → Import. Prices, limits and texts are suggestions — edit freely.

items.name: Dew Gathering Pill
items.description:
A beginner's pill condensed from the morning dew of spirit grass.

-# Made for **3rd Rate**: 50% weaker for every realm above. Each one after the first in a month is 40% weaker.

items.name: Spirit Condensing Pill
items.description:
Condenses scattered spiritual energy into the dantian.

-# Made for **1st Rate**. 30% weaker for each one already taken this month.

items.name: Azure Cloud Pill
items.description:
A Wood-aspected pill that drifts through the meridians like a cloud.

-# Made for **Master**. Max 3 per month; 30% weaker each time.

items.name: Purple Mist Elixir
items.description:
A Water-aspected elixir brewed for those standing at the Peak.

-# Made for **Peak**. Max 2 per month.

items.name: Clear Spring Pill
items.description:
Pure Qi that fights impurity — clean cultivators get the most out of it.

**Gimmick:** full potency at 0 Impurity, **−20% for every 10 Impurity** you already have.

items.name: Heaven's Dice Pellet
items.description:
Sold in back alleys by a one-eyed alchemist. Nobody knows what is inside.

**Gimmick:** 25% nothing · 45% normal · 25% double · 5% quadruple. Impurity varies between 50% and 150%. Max 4 per month.

items.name: Blood Essence Pill
items.description:
Refined from the blood of spirit beasts. Potent, but foul.

**Gimmick:** **Blood Cult** members take **half** the impurity.

items.name: Five Elements Harmony Pill
items.description:
Five colored layers, one for each element.

**Gimmick:** **+1 Qi for each element** your cultivation has a positive affinity with (max +3).

items.name: Bitter Root Tonic
items.description:
Tastes like regret. Strengthens whatever you need most.

-# Gives 2 points you can spend on any stat, including Qi. Max 2 per month; the second is half as strong.

items.name: Tiger Bone Pill
items.description:
Ground from the bones of a mountain tiger.

-# Made for **Expert**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Iron Skin Pill
items.description:
Hardens the skin like tempered iron.

-# Made for **Expert**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Swallow Feather Pill
items.description:
Makes the body as light as a swallow's feather.

-# Made for **Expert**. 35% weaker for each one taken this month.

items.name: Pill of the Middle Way
items.description:
A Taoist pill that seeks balance.

**Gimmick:** the yield always goes to your **lowest** stat (Strength, Endurance or Mobility). Max 2 per month.

items.name: Clarity Tea
items.description:
A calming tea that settles turbid Qi.

**Gimmick:** removes **25% of your current Impurity** (at least 3). Strong when you are very impure, weak when you are almost clean. Max 3 per month.

items.name: Marrow Cleansing Pill
items.description:
A violent purge that scours the marrow.

**Gimmick:** removes **30 Impurity**, but you **lose 2 Qi** with it. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Calm Heart Incense
items.description:
Inhaled during meditation before a breakthrough.

**Gimmick:** only +3%, but **never wasted** — if the attempt fails, the bonus stays for the next one. No impurity. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Foundation Establishing Pill
items.description:
Steadies the foundation before a big step.

-# Made for **1st Rate** → Expert: 50% weaker for every realm above. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Tribulation Thunder Pill
items.description:
Calls a sliver of heavenly tribulation into the body.

**Gimmick:** **+1% Realm Breakthrough for every 5 Impurity** you have (max +12%), then **+20 Impurity**. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Gate-Knocking Pill
items.description:
Only opens a gate you are already standing in front of.

**Gimmick:** +10% Realm Breakthrough **only if you already meet the next realm's requirements**. Otherwise it is wasted and gives +10 Impurity. Max 1 per month.

items.name: Phoenix Ash Elixir
items.description:
Ash from a phoenix's rebirth. Found, never sold.

**Gimmick:** +15% Realm Breakthrough and **not lost if the attempt fails** — but +40 Impurity. Max 1 per month.

items.useEffect: Blade coated with Viper Fang venom — the next hit that breaks skin delivers it.
items.name: Viper Fang Flask

poison.debuff: +10 Impurity on hit. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −5 Qi, −1 Qi Bar.
poison.gimmick: The wounded limb goes numb: T4 (Light) damage on the hit area, repeating over 2 turns.
poison.activation: Coat a blade; enters through broken skin. One coating lasts one hit.

items.description: A small flask of green venom milked from a mountain viper.

items.useEffect: Weapon (or drink) laced with Crimson Scorpion Venom.
items.name: Crimson Scorpion Venom

poison.debuff: +30 Impurity on hit. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −20 Qi, −2 Qi Bars, −5 Endurance.
poison.gimmick: Burns from within: T6 damage on the hit area over 2 turns; T7 if it reaches an internal organ or is swallowed.
poison.activation: Coat a weapon, or mix into food or drink.

items.description: Venom from the red scorpions of the western deserts. Smells faintly of cinnamon.

items.useEffect: A cloud of Ghost Lotus Powder is thrown — anyone within arm's reach who breathes it in is affected.
items.name: Ghost Lotus Powder

poison.debuff: +30 Impurity. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −20 Qi, −2 Qi Bars, −5 Mobility.
poison.gimmick: Sight blurs: the target's Mobility counts one tier lower in comparisons for 2 turns.
poison.activation: Thrown as a cloud and inhaled within arm's reach. Wind can carry it away.

items.description: Pale powder from a lotus that only blooms over graves.

items.useEffect: The jar of Heaven-Severing Miasma is opened — everyone nearby who breathes is at risk, including you.
items.name: Heaven-Severing Miasma

poison.debuff: +50 Impurity. If the target has 20+ Impurity: −50 Qi, −4 Qi Bars, −10 Strength and −10 Endurance.
poison.gimmick: Severs the link to Heaven: the target cannot use Standard Skills for 2 turns.
poison.activation: Released from a sealed jar; inhaled. Affects everyone in a small room, including the user if unprotected.

items.description: A forbidden poison sealed in black porcelain. Its recipe was burned with its maker.

items.useEffect: T1 Wood purification: halves a T1 poison and removes its gimmick; halves a T2 poison's numbers. Useless against Metal, weaker against Fire.
items.name: Green Antidote Pill
items.description: A common antidote every traveling martial artist carries.

items.useEffect: T2 Earth purification: removes T1 poisons, halves T2 and removes its gimmick, halves T3. Useless against Wood, weaker against Metal.
items.name: Yellow Earth Antidote

purification.gimmick: If it removes a poison completely, the user also loses 5 Impurity.

items.description: Brewed from earth-root and ginseng skin. Thick and sweet.

items.useEffect: A cloud of smoke for 2 turns: anyone attacking you through it counts their Mobility advantage one tier lower. Once per encounter.
items.name: Smoke Pellet
items.description: Favored by bandits, assassins and cowards alike.

items.useEffect: Restores 1 Qi Bar during a fight (once per encounter). Taking it mid-fight must be stated in your post.
items.name: Qi Restoration Pill
items.description:
A quick pill that refills an emptied Qi Bar.

**Gimmick:** restores **1 Qi Bar** in a fight, once per encounter — but still gives 8 Impurity. Every use is logged for staff.

items.name: Spirit Grass
items.description: A common herb that absorbs ambient Qi. Used in many pill recipes (see Crafting).

items.name: Thousand-Year Ginseng
items.description: A ginseng root that has drunk the earth's Qi for a thousand years. Key ingredient of higher pills.
